context.purpose: Import typed related tables and publish an exact grouped relational summary plus a fresh database.
context.assumptions: SQLite 3.54.1 CLI; local JSON row arrays, printable ASCII text, exact bounded integers, parent tables before children.
context.constraints: 1–4 tables, 0–2048 rows/table, 1–12 columns, 1–3 group fields; one declared FK inner join, integer >= filter and SUM/COUNT. No authored SQL, existing databases, network or extensions.
context.inspection: Compare raw query.stdout, summary.json/CSV and schema.sql; the verifier checks every native table row and literal nested-loop join/group semantics through an independent standard-library reopen.
context.recovery: INVALID_TABLE_KEY: choose an earlier primary key with the same declared type. INVALID_TABLE_QUERY: choose qualified active columns and a declared FK join. INVALID_TABLE_SOURCE/INVALID_TABLE_DATA: read observed.reason, table, row and column, then fix the named source, column membership, null/type/key violation or orphan foreign key. INCOMPLETE_EXECUTION: a failed run was not verified; fix the recorded faultCode and rerun in a fresh directory. INTERPRETER_NOT_FOUND: configure sqlite3.

workflow.scope: Verified numeric JSON values can feed downstream declared workflow fields; database and CSV artifacts remain explicit publications.

composition.scope: Shared references, closed expressions and finite visits resolve to the same literal typed contract.

lifecycle.timeout: One total deadline covers CLI version/import/readonly-query and final verification; per-process CPU 30s, address space 512MiB and file 16MiB caps.
lifecycle.cancellation: Shared owned-process group cancellation; check cancellation before publication. Failed runs retain explicit failed status.
lifecycle.logs: Retain authored/effective plans, immutable table captures, source digests, generated SQL/schema, exact CLI launchers/input hashes/command submissions/stdout/stderr and output membership.
lifecycle.verification: Independent literal row-by-row nested-loop join, filter and group oracle; read-only immutable stdlib database reopen compares every typed row and exact schema, integrity and foreign keys. Raw readonly native query JSON must match oracle; CSV null token is explicit.

losses: Only bounded local JSON row arrays with INTEGER/TEXT cells; no floats, dates, blobs, expressions, arbitrary SQL or existing database inputs.
One inner join from the base table through a declared foreign key to a unique primary key; no left join or many-to-many expansion.
Filter is integer >=; grouping uses binary collation with null first; sum ignores null and is null for all-null groups; count includes every surviving row.
Integers are exact in [-1000000000,1000000000]; text is printable ASCII (at most 256 characters), excluding the reserved CSV null token \N.
CSV represents null as \N; empty strings stay empty. JSON/database preserve integer, text and null types; no units or decimal arithmetic are inferred.
data.scope: Each regular local source at most 1MiB and 2048 rows; all columns and keys declared.

losses: No views, triggers, existing database editing or external resources.

losses: No units, decimal arithmetic or null/empty-string conflation.
